recognize_zh: 大片漿細胞樣腫瘤細胞的細胞質強烈 CD79a 陽性，核圓、偏心，核旁常見淡染的高爾基區（perinuclear hof），細胞質染色豐富而核不染，顯示這是漿細胞分化的 B 系細胞；在移植後病人，符合漿細胞瘤樣 PTLD。
features: Sheets of plasmacytoid cells with abundant cytoplasm
Strong granular cytoplasmic CD79a staining in the majority of cells
Round, eccentric nuclei with vesicular chromatin; some with visible nucleoli
Paler paranuclear zones (hof) in some cells
Scattered negative stromal/endothelial nuclei; no clear small lymphoid background
describe_en: CD79a immunohistochemistry shows sheets of plasmacytoid cells with abundant cytoplasm, eccentric round nuclei, and strong granular cytoplasmic staining, with focal paranuclear clearing. Scattered stromal cells are negative. The pattern confirms B-lineage cells with plasmacytic differentiation, which is typically retained when CD20 and PAX5 are lost. In a transplant recipient with EBER positivity and light-chain restriction, the findings are consistent with plasmacytoma-like monomorphic post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, EBV-positive.

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma has larger immunoblastic cells with prominent central nucleoli, frequent mitoses/starry-sky pattern and Ki-67 >80%, whereas these cells are more mature plasmacytoid.
Myeloma-type plasmacytoma is usually EBV-negative, often CD56/cyclin D1-positive and associated with systemic disease rather than the post-transplant setting.
Plasmacytic hyperplasia is polytypic and preserves tissue architecture, unlike a destructive monotypic sheet.
DLBCL comprises large centroblastic/immunoblastic cells usually retaining CD20/PAX5 rather than uniform plasma cell morphology.
